questions.question: In Jesus' story about servants staying alert at night, who were the servants waiting for?
In Jesus' story of servants waiting up, what did the master do when he came home and found them on watch?

answers.text: He waited on them at the table
He gave each one a bag of silver
He let them sleep until morning
